target: Dawn Stage visual-world replacement across Office, Mission, Company, and onboarding

references: AI Town for an inhabited 2D workplace with meaningful movement
Contemporary animation backgrounds for authored light, adult characters, and clean spatial staging
Native Mac software for restrained semantic controls and keyboard access

probes.summary: A gallery-grade architectural plate with restrained graphite chrome.
The selected panoramic continuous studio: a cinematic frontal animation stage with cobalt, rose, coral, and sparse backstage controls.
A meticulous high-resolution pixel workplace in a dark lacquer frame.

projectCheck.command: swift build && swift test && openspec validate add-core-product-navigation --strict && git diff --check && ./scripts/package-app.sh debug && codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 dist/AgentOffice.app

evidence.reviewNote: The finish review found no P0. Both P1 findings and all three P2 findings were resolved before packaging: per-employee VoiceOver controls, semantic onboarding type, honest disabled-button styling, populated-lane emphasis, and quiet final-onboarding scene labels.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner said the execution was good but still did not like the visual world, and redirected the product toward a black-and-white secret-bureau theme inspired by Men in Black.
